name: Holiday Nights at Sunset Walk
when_note: Select nights through December 25, 6 PM to 10 PM, tree lighting at 6:30 PM
paras: The Promenade at Sunset Walk in Kissimmee hosts Holiday Nights on select evenings from November 27 through December 25, 2026, from 6 PM to 10 PM. Admission and parking are free, and the venue says pets are welcome.
Santa Claus and his Mischievous Elves visit, and towering toy soldiers line the Promenade. A 40-foot animated Christmas tree lights up nightly at 6:30 PM.
Nightly snow falls, s'more fire pits at The Wharf and live music round out the evening. Holiday Nights craft and street markets and car shows are also listed.

The Pearl Express train tour costs $8 per ride and departs from the North Pole Roundabout. A trampoline ride is $15. Dance Station Studios performs holiday shows on December 14, 16 and 21 from 6 to 7:15 PM.
The select nights are November 27 to 29, December 3 to 6, December 10 to 13 and December 17 to 25.
tip: Arrive before 6:30 PM so the kids can see the 40-foot tree lighting.

name: Christmas in the Cloud
paras: Amazing Animals Inc. holds its 7th annual Christmas in the Cloud on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 11 AM to 4 PM at its wildlife preserve in St. Cloud.

Families can meet Santa and Mrs. Claus, visit the petting zoo and animal meet and greets, and see more than 25 holiday animal inflatables. Local vendors and food trucks are on site, and the preserve makes fake snow.
Experience Kissimmee lists the cost as $10 per person. The preserve is normally open by appointment only, so this is a public event day.
Questions can go to the preserve at (407) 719-6269.
tip: The preserve is visit by appointment only the rest of the year, so this event is a rare open day.
